question: Show all client names and the number of orders each has made.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "clients" AS SELECT "idclient" AS "idclient", "name" AS "name" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders" AS SELECT "idorder" AS "idorder", "idclient" AS "idclient" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT idclient, COUNT(*) AS orders_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY idclient
)
SELECT c.name AS client_name, COALESCE(oc.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count
FROM clients c
LEFT JOIN order_counts oc USING (idclient)
ORDER BY client_name
S:
